notes.title: Bug fix 24/07/2024
notes.content:
Fixed a crash that occurred during tutorial if you right-click a building while no rover was selected.

Fixed a bug that prevented Escape key from properly opening the menu while in the tutorial.

notes.title: Update 11-06-2024
notes.content:
-- Fixed bug that prevented using the right mouse button to move during certain steps in the tutorial
-- Several under-the-hood optimizations to improve performance, and lay the groundwork for planned features

notes.title: UI update
notes.content: Added an option in the Help menu to change the UI Scale as well as the date/time format displayed in the Save and Load dialogs.
